pairs.target: xǔ zhào bǎ juànliánmén tái dào yíbàn ,
pairs.english: Zhao raised the roller shutter halfway,
pairs.hanzi: 许照把卷帘门抬到一半，

pairs.english: and the shutter jammed.
She crouched down,

pairs.target: cóng guǐdào lǐ kōuchū yìméi fāhēi de luósī .
pairs.english: and pried a blackened screw out of the track.
pairs.hanzi: 从轨道里抠出一枚发黑的螺丝。

pairs.english: The screw was not from the shutter.
When her father used to repair things,

pairs.target: chāi xià de xiǎo língjiàn suíshǒu wǎng ěrduo hòumiàn jiá ,
pairs.english: he would casually tuck the small parts he removed behind his ear,
pairs.hanzi: 拆下的小零件随手往耳朵后面夹，

pairs.target: zhǎobùzhe le biàn guài dì bùpíng .
pairs.english: and when he could not find them, he would blame the uneven floor.
The floor was still uneven now;

pairs.target: guài tā de rén méi le .
pairs.english: the person who blamed it was gone.
She slipped the screw into her pocket,
and pushed the shutter open with her shoulder.

pairs.target: hé fēng guǒ zhe cháiyóu wèi zuānjìn pùzi .
pairs.english: The river wind slipped into the shop carrying the smell of diesel.
pairs.hanzi: 河风裹着柴油味钻进铺子。

pairs.target: duìàn zhèngzài chāi jiù hòuchuán péng ,
pairs.english: Across the river, they were dismantling the old ferry shelter;
every time a sheet of metal came down,

pairs.target: zhèbiān de bōlíguì jiù qīngqīng xiǎng yíxià .
pairs.english: the glass cabinet on this side gave a faint rattle.
pairs.hanzi: 这边的玻璃柜就轻轻响一下。

pairs.target: xǔ zhào cādiào guìmiàn shàng de huī ,
pairs.english: Zhao wiped the dust off the cabinet top,
revealing the price list underneath:
Plug replacement, five yuan.

pairs.target: wǔ zì bèi fùqīn miáo guò liǎngbiàn ,
pairs.english: Her father had traced over the word five twice,
as though afraid people would think it too cheap.

pairs.target: qiáo yí duān zhe yìwǎn miàn zhàn zài ménkǒu ,
pairs.english: Aunt Qiao stood in the doorway holding a bowl of noodles,
pairs.hanzi: 乔姨端着一碗面站在门口，

pairs.english: a kettle dangling from her other hand.
“Eat first, or fix it first?”
“Which one pays?”
“The noodles are on me.
If you can fix the kettle, then we can talk money.”
Zhao took the kettle,

pairs.target: méi jiē zhè jù piányi huà .
pairs.english: but did not take up that bit of convenient talk.
There was a burnt smell at the bottom of the kettle,
and the switch would not spring back when pressed down.

pairs.target: tā bádiào shì diànbǎn de chātóu ,
pairs.english: She pulled out the plug of the test power strip,
opened the base,

pairs.target: yòng nièzǐ tiāochū yìzhī kǎogān de zhāngláng .
pairs.english: and picked out a heat-dried cockroach with tweezers.
pairs.hanzi: 用镊子挑出一只烤干的蟑螂。

pairs.target: qiáo yí bǎ miàn wǎng yuǎnchù nuó le nuó .
pairs.english: Aunt Qiao moved the noodles a little farther away.
pairs.hanzi: 乔姨把面往远处挪了挪。

pairs.english: “How did it get in?”
“That is not my department.”
Zhao cleaned the contacts,

pairs.target: huàn le dànpiàn , chóngxīn zhuāng hǎo .
pairs.english: replaced the spring strip and put it back together.
When the water boiled,
the switch snapped up with a click.
At the sound, Aunt Qiao
relaxed her shoulders,

pairs.target: fǎngfú xiūhǎo de búshì hú , shì tā zìjǐ .
pairs.english: as though it was she herself who had been fixed, rather than the kettle.
pairs.hanzi: 仿佛修好的不是壶，是她自己。

pairs.english: “Fifteen,” Zhao said.

pairs.target: qiáo yí kàn le yìyǎn guì xià de jiàmùbiǎo .
pairs.english: Aunt Qiao took a glance at the price list beneath the glass.
pairs.hanzi: 乔姨看了一眼柜下的价目表。

pairs.english: “Replacing a plug is only five yuan.”
“Your problem is not the plug.”

pairs.target: " nǐ bà cóngláibù shōu jiēfāng gōngqián . "
pairs.english: “Your dad never charged the neighbours for labour.”

pairs.target: xǔ zhào bǎ nà zhī zhāngláng liántóng fèi dànpiàn tuī dào tā miànqián .
pairs.english: Zhao pushed the cockroach and the discarded spring strip in front of her.
pairs.hanzi: 许照把那只蟑螂连同废弹片推到她面前。

pairs.target: qiáo yí tāochū shǒujī , sǎo le èrshíyuán .
pairs.english: Aunt Qiao took out her phone and scanned to pay twenty yuan.
pairs.hanzi: 乔姨掏出手机，扫了二十元。

pairs.english: The extra five yuan,

pairs.target: tā shuō shì qǐng xǔ zhào bǎ nà dōngxī rēng yuǎn yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: she said, was to ask Zhao to throw that thing a little farther away.
pairs.hanzi: 她说是请许照把那东西扔远一点。

pairs.english: The noodles had already clumped together.
Zhao teased them apart with her chopsticks;
a fried egg lay hidden underneath.
She did not look outside the door,
but lowered her head and bit into the yolk.

pairs.target: fùqīn zǒu hòu , jiēfāng zǒng ná chī de lái ,
pairs.english: Since her father died, the neighbours were always bringing food,
pairs.hanzi: 父亲走后，街坊总拿吃的来，

pairs.target: fǎngfú tā zhǐyào zuǐlǐ yǒu dōngxī ,
pairs.english: as though as long as she had something in her mouth,
pairs.hanzi: 仿佛她只要嘴里有东西，

pairs.target: jiù búhuì shuōchū ràng dàjiā nánshòu dehuà .
pairs.english: she would not say anything that made everyone uncomfortable.
pairs.hanzi: 就不会说出让大家难受的话。

pairs.target: tā chī wán miàn , bǎ wǎn sònghuí gébì .
pairs.english: She finished the noodles and returned the bowl next door.
pairs.hanzi: 她吃完面，把碗送回隔壁。

pairs.english: Aunt Qiao was kneading dough,
white flour clinging to her wrists;
she did not ask Zhao how business was,

pairs.target: zhī ràng tā bǎ wǎn gēxià .
pairs.english: only told her to set down the bowl.

pairs.target: qiángshàng de jiù guàzhōng màn le qīfēnzhōng ,
pairs.english: The old clock on the wall was seven minutes slow.
pairs.hanzi: 墙上的旧挂钟慢了七分钟，

pairs.target: xǔ zhào shēnshǒu qù zhāi , qiáo yí gǎnjǐn lánzhù .
pairs.english: Zhao reached to take it down, but Aunt Qiao hurried to stop her.
pairs.hanzi: 许照伸手去摘，乔姨赶紧拦住。

pairs.english: “Leave it alone.

pairs.target: zhào zhège diǎn guān huǒ , tāng zhènghǎo . "
pairs.english: If I turn off the heat by that time, the soup is just right.”
She withdrew her hand.

pairs.target: zhè tiáo jiēshàng de dōngxī sìhū dōu yǒu zìjǐ de dàolǐ ,
pairs.english: Everything on this street seemed to have its own logic;
pairs.hanzi: 这条街上的东西似乎都有自己的道理，

pairs.english: even what was broken was broken in a way that found its proper place.

pairs.target: tā zài chénglǐ zuò shòuhòu shí ,
pairs.english: When she worked in after-sales service in the city,

pairs.target: gōng dān shàng zhǐyǒu gùzhàng , chǔlǐ , kèhù qiānzì sān lán ,
pairs.english: the job sheet had only three fields: fault, action taken, customer signature.
pairs.hanzi: 工单上只有故障、处理、客户签字三栏，

pairs.target: méiyǒu yìlán róng dé xià qīfēnzhōng de tāng .
pairs.english: Not one field had room for seven minutes of soup.
pairs.hanzi: 没有一栏容得下七分钟的汤。

pairs.english: Back at the shop,
she pulled out the price list,
wanting to replace it with a new sheet.
The paper had already grown brittle;
one corner was stuck to the glass,
and pulling it free would tear a piece off.
She fetched a thin blade,
and slowly scraped along the cabinet top,
working until her forehead broke into sweat,

pairs.target: zhōngyú wánzhěng jiēxià nà zhāng zhǐ .
pairs.english: until at last she lifted the sheet off intact.
On the new sheet,

pairs.target: tā xiān xiě le liǎnggè zì : xiūlǐ .
pairs.english: she first wrote two characters: Repairs.

pairs.target: zhìyú jiàqián , děng yǒurén lái wèn zàishuō .
pairs.english: As for prices, she would discuss them when someone came to ask.
pairs.hanzi: 至于价钱，等有人来问再说。

pairs.english: A fine rain began in the afternoon.
She tidied a drawer,

pairs.target: zhǎodào qī bǎ méiyǒu pèiduì de yàoshi ,
pairs.english: finding seven keys without matching locks,
pairs.hanzi: 找到七把没有配对的钥匙、

pairs.target: bànjuàn juéyuánjiāodài hé yìzhāng kòngbái shōujù .
pairs.english: half a roll of insulating tape and a blank receipt.
pairs.hanzi: 半卷绝缘胶带和一张空白收据。

pairs.target: shōujù bèimiàn yǒu fùqīn liúxià de bàngè xiéyìn .
pairs.english: On the back of the receipt was half a shoe print left by her father.
pairs.hanzi: 收据背面有父亲留下的半个鞋印。

pairs.target: tā fānguòlái , yā zài bōlí dǐxià ,
pairs.english: She turned it over and pressed it beneath the glass,
pairs.hanzi: 她翻过来，压在玻璃底下，

pairs.english: only then realizing both the front and back were visible.
pairs.hanzi: 才发觉正反两面都看得见。

pairs.english: Someone coughed in the doorway.

pairs.target: lǎorén chuānzhe xǐ bái de lánbù wàitào ,
pairs.english: The old man wore a blue cotton jacket washed nearly white,
pairs.hanzi: 老人穿着洗白的蓝布外套，

pairs.english: holding a radio against his chest,
cradled in a transparent plastic bag.

pairs.target: dài dǐ jī le shuǐ , jīqì quèshì gān de .
pairs.english: Water had pooled at the bottom of the bag, yet the radio was dry.
pairs.hanzi: 袋底积了水，机器却是干的。

pairs.target: tā kuàguò ménkǎn shí xiān tái yòujiǎo ,
pairs.english: Crossing the threshold, he lifted his right foot first;
pairs.hanzi: 他跨过门槛时先抬右脚，

pairs.target: luò wěn le , cái bǎ zuǒjiǎo tuōjìnlái .
pairs.english: only after planting it firmly did he drag his left foot in.
pairs.hanzi: 落稳了，才把左脚拖进来。

pairs.english: “Fix this.”
Zhao took the radio.
Blue thread was wound around the handle;
a corner was missing from the tuning knob.
She turned it over to the back.

pairs.target: diànchí gài hěn sōng , yí pèng jiù diào le .
pairs.english: The battery cover was so loose it fell off at a touch.
pairs.hanzi: 电池盖很松，一碰就掉了。

pairs.english: The battery compartment was empty,

pairs.target: huángpiàn shàng jié le yìcéng lǜ xiù .
pairs.english: a layer of green corrosion coating the spring contacts.
“How long has it been out of use?”
The old man did not answer.

pairs.target: tā kànzhe guì lǐ de kòngbái shōujù ,
pairs.english: He looked at the blank receipt in the cabinet,
pairs.hanzi: 他看着柜里的空白收据，

pairs.target: bǎ sùliàodài mànmàn zhé chéng yígè fāngkuài .
pairs.english: slowly folding the plastic bag into a square.
pairs.hanzi: 把塑料袋慢慢折成一个方块。

pairs.english: “Which station do you want to listen to?”

pairs.target: xǔ zhàohuàn le gè wèn fǎ .
pairs.english: Zhao tried a different way of asking.
“None of them.”
“Then what am I fixing?”
The old man extended his index finger,

pairs.target: tíng zài lǎba qián , méi pèngshàng qù .
pairs.english: stopping in front of the speaker without touching it.
“There is a sound inside.
Do not repair it away.”

pairs.target: yǔshuǐ yánzhe mén cáo wǎng xià tǎng .
pairs.english: Rainwater trickled down along the door channel.
Zhao waited a moment,
and, certain this was not a joke,
fetched a small china dish
to hold the screws she removed.
She had not plugged it in.

pairs.target: lǎorén què bǎshǒu àn zài jīké shàng ,
pairs.english: But the old man pressed his hand against the casing,
pairs.hanzi: 老人却把手按在机壳上，

pairs.english: his palm rough,

pairs.target: zhǐjiǎ fènglǐ yǒu xǐbúdiào de hēi .
pairs.english: black grime that would not wash off lodged under his nails.
pairs.hanzi: 指甲缝里有洗不掉的黑。

pairs.english: “Can I pick it up today?”
“I have to take a look first.”
“I will wait.”

pairs.target: tā gěi tā bān le zhāng dèngzǐ .
pairs.english: She brought a stool for him.

pairs.target: lǎorén bú zuò , réng zhàn zài guì qián .
pairs.english: The old man did not sit, remaining in front of the cabinet.

pairs.target: tā hūrán bú dà yuànyì dāngzhe tā de miàn chāixiàqù ,
pairs.english: Suddenly she was not quite willing to keep dismantling it in his presence,
pairs.hanzi: 她忽然不大愿意当着他的面拆下去，

pairs.target: xiàngshì yào zài rén yǎnqián jiǎnkāi yíjiàn tiē shēnchuān le xǔduōnián de yīshang .
pairs.english: as though she were about to cut open, before his eyes, a garment worn close to the skin for many years.
pairs.hanzi: 像是要在人眼前剪开一件贴身穿了许多年的衣裳。

pairs.target: xǔ zhào sōngkāi shǒu , qù hòu wū dǎoshuǐ .
pairs.english: Zhao released her hands and went to the back room to pour some water.
pairs.hanzi: 许照松开手，去后屋倒水。

pairs.english: Before she had even found a cup,

pairs.target: wàimiàn xiǎng le yìshēng duǎncù de shàoyīn .
pairs.english: a short, sharp whistle sounded out front.
pairs.hanzi: 外面响了一声短促的哨音。

pairs.english: She thought it was the construction across the river,

pairs.target: huítóu què kànjiàn lǎorén wǔzhù le shōuyīnjī de lǎba .
pairs.english: but turned to see the old man covering the radio speaker with his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 回头却看见老人捂住了收音机的喇叭。

pairs.english: His hand was shaking;
the plastic bag had fallen beside his feet,

pairs.target: zhé hǎo de fāngkuài yòu sànkāi le .
pairs.english: its neatly folded square coming undone again.

pairs.target: nà shēngyīn cóng tā zhǐfèngjiān lòuchūlái ,
pairs.english: The sound leaked out between his fingers,
pairs.hanzi: 那声音从他指缝间漏出来，

pairs.english: carrying the rustle of electrical static,

pairs.target: qīngchǔ dé xiàng yǒurén gé zhe shòupiào chuāng shuōhuà .
pairs.english: as clear as someone speaking through a ticket window.
pairs.hanzi: 清楚得像有人隔着售票窗说话。

pairs.target: " liùdiǎn sìshí nà bān , hái zǒu bu zǒu ? "
pairs.english: “That six-forty ferry—is it still going or not?”
Zhao looked towards the river.

pairs.target: hòuchuán péng zhī shèngxià jǐgēn zhùzi ,
pairs.english: Only a few posts remained of the ferry shelter;
pairs.hanzi: 候船棚只剩下几根柱子，

pairs.target: yǔ cóng kōng chù luò jìnqù .
pairs.english: rain fell into the empty space.
“Do not answer,” the old man said.
